title: SpiritPlaceholders
description: Just custom placeholders for your server.
body:
SpiritPlaceholders is a lightweight PlaceholderAPI expansion plugin that allows you to create custom placeholders.

<details>
<summary>Config example</summary>

```
enable: true

placeholders:
    server_name: "Example" # %spiritplaceholders_server_name%
    server_site: "example.com" # %spiritplaceholders_server_site%
    server_discord: "discord.gg/example" # %spiritplaceholders_server_discord%
    balance: "%vault_eco_balance%" # %spiritplaceholders_balance%
```

</details>
